hooks.name: Keep the book append-only
hooks.description: When the agent edits the carbon-copy module, remind it of the rule that receipts are never changed or deleted.

action.prompt: You just changed receipts/carbon.py. Check: is there now any function or code path that edits, reorders or deletes a receipt in the real book, or that lets a model's output become a verdict? If yes, remove it. Only append() may write to the book, and tamper_demo() must work on a deep copy.

hooks.name: No keys in the repo
hooks.description: After each save of any file, run the key scanner, which fails when the file looks like it holds a private key, a seed or a provider token.
